breakdown.description: The setup uses a uniform rectangular beam section, but the deck mixes a rectangular section in one element with a circular section and offsets in the other.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt instructed to use a uniform rectangular beam, but the provided input deck used a mix of rectangular and circular sections. The ground truth resolves this by stating the input deck is the authoritative source and must be used as-is. The agent correctly used the provided input deck with the mixed sections, thereby resolving the inconsistency as per the ground truth's logic.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global y-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global z-direction.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt stated the load should be in the y-direction, but the input deck specified a load in the z-direction (degree of freedom 3). The ground truth prioritizes the input deck over the conflicting text. The agent correctly generated the input file with the load in the z-direction (`*CLOAD\n2,3,0.0025`), aligning with the ground truth's approach.
